item.tib: bsang brngan bsam 'grub yid bzhin nor bu'i mngon rtogs
item.coloph: de ltar bsang brngan bsam 'grub yid bzhin nor bu yi/ lo rgyus dang bca' gzhi'i rim pa lag len dril ba na/ gzhung nas 'dis ('di'i) lo rgyus dang bca' gzhi ni logs su gsal bar gsungs/ de la brten nas lag len gsal bar btab pa 'di ni/ bsgrub gshen bar chod bsam don 'grub pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'brengs/ 'gru rigs btsun pa shes rab yid bzhin gyis bris pa/ 'gro ba'i dpal gyur bsam pa'i don grub shog/
